received_works.body:
Nice to meet you. Hello~
If you’re available, I’d like to request an illustration of my friend’s virtual character, “Lingxi,”
in the reference section below.

I’d like you to draw her looking cute and elegant.
I hope you won’t need to include her headpiece.

Feel free to adjust the details as you see fit. I’ll leave the composition and background up to you.
Please draw her as cute as possible!

Also, if possible, I’d appreciate it if you could provide the file in PSD format with separate layers for the character and background.
Thank you in advance!

Reference: https://i.postimg.cc/L5Sv2fRs/4533ff965bbde1c399ce202921299dc4.jpg

Hello!

I would like you to draw Lazuli! She is a cheerful fish vtuber! she has a big tail, patches of scales on her body, and has a blue tongue and mouth.

Lazuli's reference:
https://x.com/l4zufish/status/2018026370513973340
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1hk1_nf3VPt4yddq3oQ4bf4IpIAAPUu01

I really like this art: https://skeb.jp/@fruitsrabbit/works/95
I would like to request something similar with Lazuli and her fan mascots!
Fan mascot reference can be found in the "2 - Mascot" folder in the google drive link.

Please draw a younger version of Lazuli sitting on the beach, meeting her fan mascots for the first time! both Lazuli and the fan mascots should both look curious of each other. Any other details are up to you!

I would like to post this artwork on twitter and Lazuli may wish to use this art for things like youtube thumbnails or posting on SNS

Thank you for reading!

Nice to meet you. My name is Uron.
I’ve been finding great comfort in the delicate and adorable girls drawn by fruitsrabbit on pixiv.
I’ve been waiting for Skeb to resume. I’d really love to submit a request!

As for the request, I’d like you to draw an illustration of the avatar I use in VRChat.
She’s a black-haired girl with cat ears, characterized by her buck teeth and heart-shaped eyes.
Feel free to adjust the design slightly to make it easier for you to draw.
I’ll leave the pose and composition up to you, but I’d be happy if you could draw her in a cute way.

■ Reference Materials
・3D Reference
https://hub.vroid.com/characters/2301141102479844006/models/189121951310495665
・Image References
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RstOzRO-iVKuZvC7yRsHeJtQIXR6WOZh

Thank you for your consideration!

Nice to meet you.
My name is Eborubu-chan.

I’ve had the pleasure of seeing your wonderful past illustrations!
I would love for you to draw an illustration of my favorite VTuber, Mihiro Amamine!!

I’ll leave the outfit, expression, and composition entirely up to you.
For the hairstyle, please use one of the two styles featured in her new outfit. (Please refer to Reference Materials: New Hairstyles 1 and 2.)
Please design her in the way you think will look best when you draw Mihiro Amamine. She is a VTuber who is active in various fields, including singing streams, gaming, and cooking.
Also, if possible, I would appreciate it if you could provide one alternate version of her smiling face.
(Please refer to the reference materials for a cheerful smile showing her teeth.)

Intended Use:
For use as thumbnails for live streams and videos on YouTube channels (including monetized channels)
For use as icons and in posts on various social media platforms
For the sale of various merchandise, etc.

Given the intended uses listed above, please deliver the file in PSD format with the character separated from the background.

I apologize for the inconvenience, but I would really appreciate your help!


Reference Materials:
https://youtube.com/@amanemihiro
(Amane Mihiro YouTube Channel)
https://x.com/i/status/1916539509845770411 (New Outfit & New Hairstyle 1)
https://www.youtube.com/live/JXPdo7kLQxk?si=W_1Rrkvgl9N_NCeM (New Hairstyle 2)
https://x.com/evolvechan/status/1669119088457822208
(Reference image of a smile showing teeth)

Hello again!~
I would like cute illustration of my lamb VTuber ! https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1vL56Shx2r_H0VlS8QG8qb96r8UZaLdey

Please make her petite with a flat chest.
Please make her blushing shyly like in the main reference.
Her eyes are different colors , one light pink and the other light gold.
She has a mole under the gold eye.
Her front bangs are very long, not short.
Please include her mascot.

The background and atmosphere should be soft and pastel!
Pose can be anything cute with a summer theme, please! 
Thank you so much ~

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1vL56Shx2r_H0VlS8QG8qb96r8UZaLdey

Nice to meet you, hello. I'd like to commission an illustration for OC "Nami" featuring her new costume theme, "Puppeteer." I'm hoping for an overall atmosphere that's "cute, gentle, and fairy-tale-like." Composition and pose are entirely up to you, but I'd love it if Nami's expression is clearly visible and conveys a slightly airheaded, soft-hearted cuteness.

Nami is a little dinosaur girl living in the human world, working as a puppeteer to hide her true identity. She's a bit shy and airheaded, but inside she's very emotionally rich. Her true feelings are expressed by her puppet instead. The puppet possesses weather magic: When angry, small clouds or thunder appear; When sad, a light drizzle; When happy, rainbows or stars; When embarrassed, pink clouds appear.

I would be delighted if you could express Nami and the puppet's gentle world in your style. Thank you very much. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a-EHB_Jjhs4JjQdpzQ6kAVFukOie3TAM?usp=drive_link

Hello~ I love your art so much! 

If possible, I’d like for you to draw my character. She is a demon princess with a witch hat and is chocolate waffle themed. She likes sewing plushies and making them move. I want you to draw her in the pose referenced provided, alongside her holding her bunny plushie. The background I was thinking maybe including other plushies and desserts like waffles, strawberries, chocolate, etc.

I’d like to request commercial usage because I want to use it for merchandise and streaming activities! You are free to play around with the pose and character, the only thing I ask for is that you don’t omit any details please. It is okay to simplify to fit your style though, as long as everything is included. Especially the eyes. For clarification, the left eye has a castle and the right eye is a pair of scissors ✂️. 

I apologize in advanced for having such a complicated character design. But I hope you will consider working with me. 

Thank you so much~ 💖

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1em1U_neMfc-MFjLvILMeEUr8CJVM0TRz

Hi, I really love your adorable artworks! Could you please create an illustration of my OC?

My OC has a very long lifespan, so she doesn’t have many human friends and often spends time alone, usually with a calm or expressionless face.
However, she gets along very well with small animals and feels truly happy when she’s with them.

•Composition:
Horizontal layout, with a 16:9 aspect ratio suitable for PC wallpaper
In a warm and sunny spring garden, she’s playing together with many of her animal friends— a white cat with heterochromatic blue and yellow eyes, a sika deer, a little squirrel, small yellow chicks…etc.
The background could be decorated with many blooming flowers.
(You can draw the outfit from the reference URL, and you’re also welcome to design a new outfit if you’d like.)

•Intended Use:
For display on my personal SNS
As a personal desktop wallpaper

If the amount is not enough, please feel free to resend the request 🙇🏻
Thank you very much for considering!

Hello fruitsrabbit-sensei,
